name: Spooky Splash
author: Lanecast
description: A Halloween meet, fun rather than frightening: gravestones for the event and heat, the event's name in a coffin that slides open, a zombie keeping the time, jack-o'-lanterns numbering the lanes, a ghost, witch, zombie or mummy crossing the header at each new event, and a spider that spins a web when a heat is done. Line it up with your pool in its settings.
